Statement :
One has \(|J|=d+1\), and the tropical incidence relation
\[
   \min_{e\in J\setminus S}\{p(S\cup\{e\})+\mu(J\setminus\{e\})\}
\]
must attain its minimum at least twice.
fixed_proof: This is the tropical incidence relation for the valuated quotient \(p\).
